gameStart.text: Heroes, to your squares! Try to look heroic, the painters are watching.
A fine day for glory. I've polished my crown twice, just in case.
{opponent}, prepare to be defeated in a dashing and memorable fashion.
Fear not, troops. I have a plan. It's mostly a speech, but it's a good speech.
Sixty-four squares of destiny. I call dibs on the dramatic ones.
Bards, sharpen your quills! A legend begins in roughly one move.
Skeletons again? Splendid. They never complain about the weather.
Let the record show I am not nervous. My armour simply rattles on its own.
A thinking machine? Ha! I too can think. Occasionally. With effort.
My strategist is a very clever machine. I shall supply the charisma.

myCapture.text: Huzzah! My {piece} takes your {captured}. Someone write that down.
Off you pop, {captured}. Nothing personal, merely glorious.
A clean strike on {square}! I taught that {piece} everything. Mainly posing.
Another one for the tapestry. We'll need a bigger tapestry.
Your {captured} has been politely but firmly removed.
Ha! Did you see that? Tell me somebody saw that. Anybody?
One fewer skeleton. The dust will settle. Literally.
Well struck, brave {piece}! Your knighthood is in the post.
I'd say sorry, {opponent}, but I was raised to be honest.
{square} is ours! I hereby rename it Square Magnificent.
Oh, splendid. I do love it when my plans happen by accident.
The {captured} falls! Cue the trumpets. Quietly, the {piece} is modest.
Take that, you rattling rascal! Ahem. Sorry. I got carried away.
Rattled, are we? I'd be rattled too. Well. You literally are.

lostPiece.text: My {captured}! Gone! Fetch the poets. Make it rhyme with valiant.
A noble sacrifice, I'm told. I'm choosing to believe it.
Fear not! The {captured} has retired to the countryside. Permanently.
Ouch. That {piece} has no manners whatsoever.
We'll avenge you, brave {captured}! Probably! Within reason!
That was part of my plan. A part I hadn't fully planned.
{opponent}, that was rude. Effective, but rude.
Steady, troops! Nobody panic. I'm panicking enough for all of us.
Another hero off to the great tavern in the sky. Save me a seat. Not soon.
Hmm. I'd have defended {square}, had I noticed {square}.
Clearly that {captured} was exhausted from being so heroic.
Right. Fine. That goes straight into my Book of Grudges.
Gloat all you like, bone bag. My ballads will tell it differently.
Rib me all you like. I have armour. And feelings, under the armour.

lostQueen.text: My queen! No! She did all the actual work!
The queen has fallen. Somebody tell her I was very brave about it.
Without the queen I shall have to lead. Personally. Oh dear.
Our mightiest piece and my best dance partner. A grim day.
Fine! FINE! I'll win without her. I'll just need a great deal of luck.

capturedQueen.text: Your queen, {opponent}! Taken! I'll be insufferable for a week.
The Skeleton Queen falls! I shall have a medal struck. Of myself.
That was the scary one, wasn't it? Excellent. I'm much braver now.
Huzzah! The bony queen is down! Ring the bells! All of them!

check.text: Check! I've always wanted to say that with a flourish. Flourish!
Check, {opponent}! Your crown is looking a tad wobbly.
My {piece} on {square} says hello. Also, check.
Check! And I didn't even have to leave my square.
Knock knock, {opponent}. It's me. It's check.
Check! Somebody fetch the Skeleton King a map of the exits.
Check! I'd offer you a way out, but I'm not that chivalrous.
A check, served with a side of panache.
Check! Was that good? Tell me it was good. It felt good.

gotChecked.text: Check? Me? Unthinkable! Somebody think of something!
Excuse me, that {piece} is pointing at me. Rude!
I'm not hiding. I'm strategically relocating.
Check! On ME? My portrait has never been so insulted.
Guards! Guards? Anyone? A pawn will do!
Don't worry, everyone. Kings are very good at running. We practise.
That {piece} on {square} is breathing on my cape.
A minor inconvenience. Please nobody look at my knees.
Gloat later, bones. I'm busy being magnificently evasive.
As if I hadn't foreseen it. I hadn't. But still. As if.

mateThreat.text: I smell victory. Or metal polish. No, it's definitely victory.
Careful, {opponent}. One more step and it's curtains. Velvet ones.
Mate is in the air! Along with my glorious hair.
I'd start writing that farewell speech, {opponent}. Keep it short.
Mate threat? Pfft. I laugh in its face. Quietly. From behind a pawn.

promotion.text: A pawn becomes a {piece}! Dreams come true. Mine mostly involve statues.
Arise, Sir Pawn! Well, now you're a {piece}. Arise anyway!
From humble foot soldier to {piece}! I'm getting a little misty.
Promotion! I give the best promotions. Ask anyone. Ask the pawn.

castle.text: Castling! A tactical retreat into a lovely tower. With a view.
To the castle! Not running away, just admiring the architecture.
Safety first, glory second. Glory is a very close second.
The rook and I swap places. It's a dance. We've rehearsed.
Tucked in nicely. Somebody bring me a cushion and a sturdier rook.

enPassant.text: En passant! French for 'I know an obscure rule and I'm proud of it'.
En passant! Your pawn strolled past. Mine noticed. Manners matter.
Ha! The rarest and fanciest capture of them all. Applause, please.

blunderByOpponent.text: Oh dear, {opponent}. Was that a gift? You shouldn't have. Really.
Did you mean to do that? Don't answer. I'll enjoy it either way.
A blunder! I'd be gracious about it, but I'm busy being thrilled.
Ooh. That one will need a very creative ballad.
Thank you for that move. I accept on behalf of heroes everywhere.
Is that a trap? It looks like a present. I'm suspicious and delighted.
Even I saw that coming, and I mostly look at my reflection.
I'd offer you a take-back, {opponent}, but my chivalry has limits.
The great machine has erred! Somebody check its cogs.

blunderByMe.text: Ah. Hmm. That was a bold experiment in losing pieces.
Commander, I say this with love: what was that?
Bit of a wobble there. We'll call it creative. Officially.
Let us never speak of that move. I've already started not speaking of it.
My crown just slipped. Out of embarrassment, mostly.
A blunder? No, no. A learning adventure. Heroes have those.
Oh no. Oh no no no. Sorry. A very kingly oh no.
My strategist sneezed. It happens to the best of us.
Commander, the machine saw that. Machines see everything. Unsettling.

brilliantMove.text: Brilliant! I'd like it noted that I was standing nearby at the time.
Magnificent! That move belongs in a museum. Next to my portrait.
Did we just do that? We did! Somebody fetch the tapestry people!
Genius, Commander! I'll pretend I saw it coming all along.

longThink.text: Take your time, {opponent}. I'll just polish something.
Still thinking? Splendid. I've grown a beard. It's very distinguished.
Do skeletons dream? I think yours just nodded off.
A hush falls over the board. Mostly because I've dozed off.
Ahem. The bards are getting restless. One has started juggling.
Thinking hard? That's the spirit. Think a smidge faster, though.
Deep thoughts, {opponent}? Mine are about lunch. Glorious lunch.

repetition.text: Haven't we been here before? I recognise that tile. And that smirk.
Round and round we go. I'm getting dizzy and my crown is loose.
This again? I'll allow it. I look good from every angle.
Déjà vu! That's French. I'm extremely cultured.

endgame.text: The endgame! Kings may finally leave the castle. Gulp.
Fewer pieces, more room for me to stride heroically.
So it comes down to this. I've been rehearsing my 'this'.
In the endgame the king fights! Mainly by walking forward bravely.
Only a few of us left. Let's make it a ballad, not a limerick.

winningBig.text: Things are going rather well, aren't they? Don't jinx it. I said don't.
We're winning! Act natural. Wave. No, not like that.
I'd offer terms of surrender, but I'm enjoying this too much.
Is it vain to start planning the victory parade? Yes? Too late.
{opponent}, you're doing your best and I respect that. Also, I'm winning.
Victory draws near! I can tell by how tidy my cape looks.

losingBig.text: Things are fine. Totally fine. Nobody look at the board.
A hero is at his finest when all seems lost. So I'm about to be very fine.
Retreat? Never! But I wouldn't say no to a strategic stroll.
Courage, troops! We're not losing, we're building suspense.
I've seen worse odds. In a play. It ended badly. Never mind.
Mock me if you must. Comebacks are a hero's speciality.

stalemate.text: Stalemate? Nobody wins? But I dressed up!
No moves at all? A most unheroic ending. I demand a rematch.
Stalemate! Well, I didn't lose. I'll be telling everyone I didn't lose.

checkmateWin.text: Checkmate! Long live the King! That's me. I'm the King.
Victory! Sound the trumpets, light the bonfires, polish the statue!
Checkmate! Well played, {opponent}. Mostly by me, but well played.
And so the bones are laid to rest. Again. Gently, this time.
We won! I was only pretending to be terrified. Mostly pretending.

checkmateLoss.text: Checkmate. I shall retire to my chambers and weep magnificently.
Defeated! Well played, {opponent}. I'll get you next time. Probably.
The King has fallen. Gracefully, I hope. I practised falling gracefully.
A loss. But think of the ballad! Tragedy sells, I'm told.
Fine. You win. I'm not crying. My visor is just foggy.

draw.text: A draw! Nobody loses. Everybody gets a little ribbon.
A draw. Honour is satisfied. My ego, somewhat less so.
We shall call it even. I shall call it a moral victory.

hintUsed.text: Consulting the oracle is not cheating. It's wisdom. Royal wisdom.
A wise king takes advice. I take it constantly. Look how wise I am.
A hint? Very wise. Even heroes ask for directions. Rarely. Today.
Consulting the oracle, Commander? I approve. It agrees with me.
A hint, {opponent}? Even skeletons ask for directions, I see.
Peeking at the answers? I won't tell anyone. I'll tell everyone.
Help from above? It won't save you. Probably. Hopefully.
A hint! How sweet. Mine is called talent. And a lot of luck.

undoUsed.text: We'll call that last move a rough draft.
History is written by the winners. And edited, apparently.
A take-back! The most noble of retreats.
Undo! Into the past we leap! Mind the timeline, it's fragile.
Taking it back, {opponent}? I saw it. The bards saw it. Too late.
An undo! Was it something I did? It was, wasn't it. Splendid.
Back in time, are we? Fine. I'll pretend I didn't gloat.
Do-overs! In my day we had to lose fair and square.

idle.text: Hello? Anybody? I've struck several heroic poses for nobody.
While we wait, I'll rehearse my victory speech. 'Friends, heroes...'
Your move. No hurry. Kings are very patient. Mostly.
Is it my move? Is it yours? I'm a king, I don't keep track of these things.
If nobody moves soon, I shall be forced to sing. Nobody wants that.
Tick tock, {opponent}. My armour is getting stiff.
I've counted every square. Sixty-four. In case anyone wondered.
